tariff.notes: תעריפון הבנק באינטרנט ללקוח יחיד/עסק קטן - בנק הפועלים, 'נכון ליום: 05/10/2026' (קובץ XLS, גיליון אחד; פרק: ניירות ערך, פרק: מטבע חוץ, הטבות בערוצי בנקאות בתקשורת (נספח ה')). קובץ ה-PDF התאום single_small_51026.pdf משתמש בגופן Type 3 ללא מיפוי Unicode והטקסט שלו אינו ניתן לחילוץ. מקושר מעמוד https://www.bankhapoalim.co.il/forms/he/fee-list Re-read 2026-11-04. The fee-list page (https://www.bankhapoalim.co.il/he/fee-list) still links single_small_51026.xls and .pdf ('נכון ליום: 05/10/2026'); the XLS is byte for byte the 31 October copy (md5 4fa41eb7…, library e939af51e5b97376; HTTP Last-Modified 2026-10-07), the PDF was created 2026-10-05 16:10 (library 40bd62035edbad6f), and it is the newest binding document. Annex E as its own file (145.pdf, 'נכון ליום: 02/08/2026', created 2026-07-27, modified 2026-08-05, library 0c2a960bbbf4ee62) and the short tariff with annexes (united_23926.pdf, 'נכון ליום: 01/10/2026', modified 2026-09-24, library 41f643f8f9216975) print the same securities and conversion figures. Annex A as its own file is dated 24/12/2023 (library 9d582d194457104f) and matches the sheet's club rows. The change-notice page (/he/taarifon-change) still shows only the 1.11.2021 notice. The exchange's sheet (market.tase.co.il trading_fees, 'עדכון אחרון: 26/01/25') prints the same direct rates. No account agreement with a securities fee annex is published; the general terms of 09.2023 (library 5164629834e3d870) print no securities price.

rate.notes: '0.60%'. Note (05): excludes mutual funds, Maof options and futures but includes a tracking fund (קרן מחקה) and a fund whose units are listed on TASE, so Israeli ETFs and listed fund units pay this line. Note (06): the fee never exceeds 25% of the money value. Note (03): an unexecuted order pays the minimum only when a clerk was involved; a split order pays one fee per day. Additional expenses: TASE payments per the third-party chapter. Note (07): a transaction made directly on the internet pays a reduced 0.40% subject to the appendix-E minimum and maximum. Tracking funds (2026-10-31): the exclusion of mutual funds on this line does not cover a tracking fund, so a tracking fund pays this line; a traditional fund that is not listed does not. Place: the existing record of the tariff read on 2026-10-23, note (05) above. Scope re-read 2026-10-31 in the XLS, row 958, note (05).

rate.notes: Appendix E direct-channel price '0.40%' (clerk 0.60%); also note (07) of the securities chapter: 'עבור פעולה המבוצעת ישירות באמצעות האינטרנט ייגבה שיעור מופחת של 0.40% לפעולה'. Same scope as the branch line. The appendix-E rows in the XLS interleave the direct and clerk columns in one cell; values were read against the part-4 notes. Tracking funds (2026-10-31): the exclusion of mutual funds on this line does not cover a tracking fund, so a tracking fund pays this line; a traditional fund that is not listed does not. Place: the existing record of the tariff read on 2026-10-23, note (05) above. Scope re-read 2026-10-31 in the XLS, row 958, note (05). Standing order (2026-11-04): the general terms allow a securities purchase by standing order ('הוראת רכישה המתנהלת בהוראת קבע', securities chapter s.4.2.2, p.25; s.20.4, p.27), but the price list prints no standing-order price, and note (07) gives the 0.40% only 'עבור פעולה המבוצעת ישירות באמצעות האינטרנט'. On the same wording at FIBI and Massad, a standing order's monthly execution is not such an action, so a standing order would pay the branch line, 0.60%, min 26 (an inference from note (07); Hapoalim prints nothing more on it). A purchase the reader places online each month pays this line, which is what the record prices; no standing-order line is recorded, since it would only be dearer.

Sheet row 705, note (03): the bank may charge the higher of the actions done or 'עמלת מינימום בסכום שאינו עולה על מחיר של פעולה אחת ע"י פקיד'; tracks rows 752-753. groups.note: The clubs in the sheet (rows 178-665) and the student page read in the filed copies. Students have no custody price.
